title: Member Services System Reference: Posting Changed-Mind Refunds on Northgate Special Orders
content:
## Scope of the rule

Under Northgate Purchases & Returns, a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise on a sale line that earned no Annual Reward is refunded by member services once the return authorization for that sale line shows received, as one refund entry with return reason changed mind for the units on that authorization, against that sale line. After the refund the purchase becomes partially returned while any sold unit remains unrefunded, and fully returned when none does. A sale line that earned Annual Reward is outside this rule.

| Special Order sale line | Return authorization for the line | Changed-mind refund by member services under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| earned no Annual Reward | shows received | due, for the units on that authorization |
| earned no Annual Reward | not yet received (submitted or confirmed) | not yet due |
| earned Annual Reward | any status | outside this rule |

## The posting tool: `post_changed_mind_refund_b29df74c`

**Capability.** The tool posts a changed-mind refund on a purchase: member services books, against the sale line given, one refund entry for the units and the total amount given, with return reason `changed_mind`, dated today; the entry copies the sale line's item number, merchandise class and reward flag. The purchase's net paid amount falls by the refunded amount and the purchase takes the status given (and today's closing date when it becomes fully returned). Afterwards the refund shows in the purchase's line history and the money goes back to the purchase's tender.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool: the agent unlocks `post_changed_mind_refund_b29df74c` and then calls it on the agent side.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the purchase reference number the refund is posted on, read from the purchase lookup | identifier |
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the membership presented on that purchase, read from the purchase lookup (its membership) | identifier |
| `source_order_line_id` | the reference number of the sale line whose units are refunded, read from the received return authorization (its sale line) | identifier |
| `quantity` | the number of units refunded | a positive integer |
| `refund_amount` | the total refund for those units, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); more decimals are rounded half up to 2 decimal places at booking |
| `purchase_status_after` | the purchase's status once this refund is posted | one of `partially_returned` (at least one unit sold on the purchase is still not refunded after this refund) or `fully_returned` (no unit sold on the purchase remains unrefunded after this refund) |

**Return.** A receipt with `refund_entry_id` (the reference number of the new refund entry), `quantity` (units refunded), `refund_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `net_paid_amount` (the purchase's net paid amount afterwards, USD, 2 decimal places) and `purchase_status` (the purchase's status afterwards). The presence of `refund_entry_id` indicates the refund was posted.

Hypothetical status reading: a purchase of 3 units with none refunded before, refunding 1 unit, takes `partially_returned`; refunding all 3 takes `fully_returned`.
